events.event_name: US Open Open for All Day
events.address: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, Flushing Meadows Corona Park, Flushing, NY 11368
events.what_it_is: The US Open's free public grounds-access day during the second week of the tournament, with doubles, junior, wheelchair and para-standing tennis plus sponsor activations around the grounds.
events.what_is_free: Daytime grounds admission is free. Stadium sessions and evening-session access are separate ticketed products.
events.caveats: Free access is for the grounds during the daytime. The women's semifinal session in Arthur Ashe Stadium is ticketed separately. Schedule is subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Official US Open sources confirm gates open at 11 AM on September 10. Treat the free window as daytime grounds access rather than admission to Arthur Ashe Stadium.

events.what_it_is: A one-day Palmer's Lemon Sorbet body-care pop-up with product sampling and themed treats.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a tote plus the full-size Lemon Sorbet collection. Later guests can receive a tote, deluxe samples and Lemon Sorbet treats while supplies last.
events.caveats: Full-size sets are limited to the first 50 guests. All other promotional inventory is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM, or until promotional inventory runs out. No RSVP requirement is stated in the current listings.

events.event_name: Fenty Beauty Fluid Flex NYC Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Fenty Beauty Pro Filt'r Fluid Flex pop-up with shade matching, giveaways, a photo experience and optional bottle engraving for guests who bring a pre-purchased foundation.
events.what_is_free: Entry and the pop-up experience are free. Giveaways are advertised but not guaranteed to every attendee; bottle engraving requires bringing a pre-purchased Fluid Flex bottle.
events.caveats: Entry is first-come, first-served based on occupancy. Reservations have a 10-minute grace period and do not eliminate the capacity rule.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 12–5 PM. Use the Eventbrite page for a reservation, but do not treat the reservation as guaranteed entry if capacity is reached.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW fragrance social club with scent sommeliers, a 'loose ends' confessional, coffee or matcha and a fragrance-gift reveal.
events.what_is_free: NOYZ advertises coffee or matcha plus a NOYZ gift reveal while supplies last. No purchase requirement is stated.
events.caveats: NOYZ explicitly marks the gift and coffee/matcha benefits as while supplies last. No RSVP or approval requirement is published on the official event page.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 10 AM–6 PM at 173 Elizabeth Street.

events.what_it_is: A two-day public launch pop-up for Your Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense with product discovery, makeup consultations, photo moments, a game station and themed food and drinks.
events.what_is_free: Samples and minis are advertised, including Your Devotion, Devotion for Men, Velvet Infusion, Everfull Mascara and eye patches. Exact inventory is not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current public-event listings describe the activation as open to the public. On-site bottle engraving is tied to a fragrance purchase at the adjacent Sephora; samples and minis are inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: September 12 from 12–9 PM and September 13 from 11 AM–7 PM at 38 Gansevoort Street. No advance approval requirement is stated.

events.address: Washington Square Park, Washington Square North between University Pl and Fifth Ave, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A one-day Flex pop-up ice-cream truck centered on body literacy and period-care products, with frozen treats, Flex goodies and a photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary frozen treats and Flex goodies are advertised; exact quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Promotional treats and goodies are subject to available inventory. No RSVP requirement is stated in the current listings.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–4 PM at Washington Square Park, along Washington Square North between University Place and Fifth Avenue.
